case.amplicon_range_bp: empty site 242 bp / filled site 495 bp (delta 253 bp)
case.caveats: Dimorphic locus, so the paper prints two sizes; the cited accession (BAC RP11-115M6, Xq28, 178,516 bp) carries the FILLED (Alu-present) allele, so 495 bp is the size to expect in this template. The 242 bp empty-site allele is NOT present in this accession. No degenerate bases; neither primer spans a junction. Verified by exact-string in-silico PCR against AC109993.3: exactly one product, plus strand, length 495 bp, and the Ye-lineage diagnostic 25-mer (5'-GAACCCCGGGGGGCGGAGCCTGCAG-3', the paper's own subfamily-diagnostic oligo) lies inside the amplicon, confirming it genuinely spans an Alu Ye element. Product uniqueness was confirmed within the cited accession only, not genome-wide. Annealing temperature 55 C.
case.citation: Salem AH, Ray DA, Hedges DJ, Jurka J, Batzer MA. Analysis of the human Alu Ye lineage. BMC Evolutionary Biology 2005;5:18. doi:10.1186/1471-2148-5-18. PMID 15725352; PMCID PMC554112.
case.element: Alu Ye5 (SINE, non-LTR); Alu Ye lineage insertion polymorphism
case.loci_justification: The pair flanks one locus on the cited template: a single insertion site, a single excision site, or a single transcript. A second product on this template would be an off-target prediction.

case.where_in_paper: Additional File 2, captioned "Supplemental Table. Alu Ye elements, Genbank numbers, PCR primers, annealing temperature, primate diversity, location and amplicon sizes." Columns: Name | Accession | 5' Primer sequence (5'-3') | 3' Primer sequence (5'-3') | A.T. | Diversity | Chr. Loc. | Product Size Filled | Empty. Primers and both sizes are in the Ye5AH1 row; the Accession column supplies AC109993.3.
case.worked_prediction_note: The entry records a worked prediction — a coordinate range, an in-silico check, or a sequence-derived length — so the expected answer was written down before the engine ran. The published size remains external, but this case was not scored blind.
